name: OpenRouter
billing: Model prices, provider charges and free-model limits vary. Review your available credits and key limits. A free model or a key does not imply unlimited free access.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.body: Sign in or create an OpenRouter account, then select the account or organization your application will use.

steps.title: Create an application API key
steps.body: Use the API key link on the official developer page. Name the key for this application, review its available limit controls and store it privately.

steps.title: Select a model and review credits
steps.body: Use a model identifier supported by your account, including its author prefix when required. Review the model’s current price and your credit balance.
